description: Pushes a notification when the context engine stops classifying. The master switch failing silently is invisible otherwise — other home_context automations keep firing and the frozen values stay plausible.

data.title: ⚠️ Home Context engine stalled
data.message: Observer hasn't run in {{ states('sensor.home_context_observer_age') }} min (expected every 5). {% if is_state('input_boolean.ai_context_enabled','off') %}Cause: AI Context master switch is OFF — context is frozen.{% else %}Master switch is on; check the automation trace.{% endif %}
